form.label: Stoker — Fleet Observability
form.description: Live view across every Stoker run, over the control plane's dogfood telemetry (sourcetypes stoker:metrics and stoker:job). Click a run to drill into it.

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | stats latest(state) as state by run_id | search state IN (provisioning, releasing, running, draining) | stats count
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | stats latest(eps) as eps by run_id | stats sum(eps) as fleet_eps
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | stats max(events_total) as ev by run_id | stats sum(ev) as total
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | stats max(hec_4xx) as e4 max(hec_5xx) as e5 max(hec_timeouts) as et by run_id | eval errs = e4 + e5 + et | stats sum(errs) as total_errors
index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | timechart span=30s sum(eps) as "Delivered eps" sum(target_eps) as "Target eps"

panel.title: Worst-worker pacing lag (max lag_s across the fleet)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | timechart span=30s max(lag_s_max) as "Max pacing lag (s)"

panel.title: Throughput — delivered eps by run (stacked = fleet total)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | timechart span=30s sum(eps) by run_id

panel.title: Throughput — MB/s by run (stacked = fleet total)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | eval mbps = bps / 1048576 | timechart span=30s sum(mbps) by run_id

panel.title: HEC outcomes — fleet cumulative (2xx vs errors)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | timechart span=30s sum(hec_2xx) as "2xx" sum(hec_4xx) as "4xx" sum(hec_5xx) as "5xx" sum(hec_timeouts) as "timeouts" sum(retries) as "retries"

panel.title: Runs — latest state (click a row to drill in)

search.query: index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:metrics | stats latest(state) as state latest(eps) as eps latest(target_eps) as target_eps max(events_total) as events latest(live_workers) as live latest(reporting_workers) as reporting latest(lag_s_max) as lag_s latest(_time) as last_seen by run_id spec_id | eval last_seen = strftime(last_seen, "%H:%M:%S") | sort - run_id | rename run_id as "Run" spec_id as "Spec" state as "State" eps as "Delivered eps" target_eps as "Target eps" events as "Events" live as "Live workers" reporting as "Reporting" lag_s as "Lag (s)" last_seen as "Last seen"

index=$index$ sourcetype=stoker:job | sort - _time | eval when = strftime(_time, "%H:%M:%S") | table when run_id from to end_reason degraded | rename when as "Time" run_id as "Run" from as "From" to as "To" end_reason as "End reason" degraded as "Degraded"
